content.hebrew: יְ֒צַו הָאֵל : וְהַגֹּאֵל : חֲסָדָיו אֶל : בְּנֵי הֹרִים :
content.transliteration: Yetsav ha’el : vehaggo’el : ḥasadav el : benē horim:
content.english: May God, the redeemer, order his kindness to the children of the ancestors.

content.hebrew: הֲ֒לֹא בֹּשִׁים : וַחֲלָשִׁים : שְׁמוֹ דוֹרְשִׁים : לְדוֹר דּוֹרִים :
content.transliteration: Halo boshim : vaḥalashim : shemo doreshim : ledor dorim:
content.english: They are so ashamed and weak, as they seek his name for all generations.

content.hebrew: וְ֒הֵם עוֹמְדִים : וּמִתְוַדִּים : עֲוֹן מוֹרְדִים : וְחֵטְא מוֹרִים :
content.transliteration: Vehem ‘omedim : umitvaddim : ‘avon moredim : veḥet morim:
content.english: They stand and confess their rebellious iniquities, their defiant sins.

content.hebrew: דְּ֒רוֹר הַיּוֹם : קְדוֹשׁ אָיוֹם : קְרָא פִדְיוֹם : לְנִבְחָרִים :
content.transliteration: Deror hayyom : ḳedosh ayom : ḳera fidyom : lenivḥarim:
content.english: O holy and awesome one, declare freedom, release, for the chosen people.

content.hebrew: הֲ֒גַם אַף עַל : עֲוֹן תִּגְעַל : מְחֵה מַעַל : מְפֻזָּרִים :
content.transliteration: Haḡam af ‘al : ‘avon tiḡ‘al : meḥē ma‘al : mefuzzarim:
content.english: May you also cast aside iniquity. Wipe out the rebellious deeds of the people who are so spread out in the diaspora,

content.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפּוּרִים :
content.transliteration: Be‘etsem hayyom hazzē ki yom kippurim:
content.english: On this very day, for it is a day of atonement.

content.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפּוּרִים :
content.transliteration: Be‘etsem hayyom hazzē ki yom kippurim:
content.english: On this very day, for it is a day of atonement.

content.hebrew: בְּ֒כִפּוּרִים : תְּמוּר פָּרִים : סְלַח עִבְרִים : לְחַטֹּאתָם :
content.transliteration: Bechippurim : temur parim : selaḥ ‘ivrim : leḥattotam:
content.english: On [the day of] atonement, instead of oxen, [we offer prayers]. Forgive the Hebrews of their sins,

content.hebrew: רְ֒פָא שִׁבְרָם : בְּנֵה עִירָם : פְּקַח אוֹרָם : וְיִפְעָתָם :
content.transliteration: Refa shivram : benē ‘iram : peḳaḥ oram : veyif‘atam:
content.english: Heal their brokenness, build their city [Jerusalem], enlighten their eyes and their beauty.

content.hebrew: אֱ֒לֹהֵי כֹל : וְכֹל יָכֹל : רְצֵה עַל כָּל : תְּחִנּוֹתָם :
content.transliteration: Elohē chol : vechol yachol : retsē ‘al kol : teḥinnotam:
content.english: O God of everything, you who are ompnipotent, find their supplications favorable!

content.hebrew: לְ֒ךָ בָטְחוּ : וְכַף שָׁטְחוּ : וְיִפָּתְחוּ : מְגִלּוֹתָם :
content.transliteration: Lecha vateḥu : vechaf shateḥu : veyippateḥu : meḡillotam:
content.english: They put their trust in you, and spread out their palms, and their scrolls are opened.

content.hebrew: יְ֒כֻפַּר נָא : חַטַּאת שִׂטְנָה : וְאַל יִמָּן : עֲוֹנוֹתָם :
content.transliteration: Yechuppar na : ḥattat sitna : ve’al yimman : ‘avonotam:
content.english: May their recalcitrant sins be atoned, and their iniquities not be counted,

content.hebrew: וְיִמָּחֶה : וְיִדָּחֶה : עֲוֹן עַמָּךְ : הֱיוֹת בָּרִים :
content.transliteration: Veyimmaḥē : veyiddaḥē : ‘avon ‘ammach : heyot barim:
content.english: And may your people’s iniquity be wiped out and pushed away, so that they will be pure.

content.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפּוּרִים :
content.transliteration: Be‘etsem hayyom hazzē ki yom kippurim:
content.english: On this very day, for it is a day of atonement.

content.hebrew: הֱ֒יוֹת בָּרִים : מְפֻזָּרִים : בְּלִי עָרִים : נְאוֹת רִבְְצָם :
content.transliteration: Heyot barim : mefuzzarim : beli ‘arim : ne’ot rivtsam:
content.english: That they will be pure – the ones scattered through the diaspora, away from the cities of their grassy pastures;

content.hebrew: וְ֒אֵין רוֹעֵה : כְּצֹאן תֹּעֶה : לְיַד מַתְעֶה : בְּחוּץ אַרְצָם :
content.transliteration: Ve’en ro‘ē : ketson to‘ē : leyad mat‘ē : beḥuts artsam:
content.english: They have no shepherd, like a straying flock, alongside [nations that are trying to] set them astray, outside of their land.

content.hebrew: תְּ֒חִנָּתָם : תְּרוּפָתָם : וְתַעְנִיתָם : יְהִי עֶלְצָם :
content.transliteration: Teḥinnatam : terufatam : veta‘nitam : yehi ‘eltsam:
content.english: May their supplication be their cure, and their fasting be their joy.

content.hebrew: שְׁ֒מַע נֹורָא : לְבֵן יִקְרָא : בְּעֵת צָרָה : וְלִנְחוּצָם :
content.transliteration: Shema‘ nora : leven yiḳra : be‘et tsara : velinḥutsam:
content.english: Hear, O awesome One, your child, who calls out in this time of trouble, and their straits.

content.hebrew: בְּ֒רוֹב הוֹדָךְ : לְדָל וָרָךְ : גְּמֹל חַסְדָּךְ : וְגַל קִצָּם :
content.transliteration: Berov hodach: ledal varach : gemol ḥasdach : veḡal ḳits-tsam:
content.english: With your great splendor, show your kindness to the people who are poor and tender, and reveal the time when their exile will end.

content.hebrew: שְׁלַח מַרְפֵּא : וְנֵרָפֵא : חֲמוֹל עַל עַם : יְדִיד יֹצְרִים :
content.transliteration: Shelaḥ marpē : venerafē : ḥamol ‘al ‘am : yedid yotserim:
content.english: Send a cure, and may we be cured! Have mercy for the people that is the friend of the fashioners.
content.comments: Friend of the fashioners: Meaning of Hebrew uncertain. Alternatively “O [God], friend of the fashioners,” but the meaning is hardly any more clear.

content.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפּוּרִים :
content.transliteration: Be‘etsem hayyom hazzē ki yom kippurim:
content.english: On this very day, for it is a day of atonement.

content.hebrew: יְ֒צוּרִים בָּךְ : בְּרֹב טוּבָךְ : פְּרִי נִיבָךְ : שְׂפָתָיִם :
content.transliteration: Yetsurim bach : berov tuvach : peri nivach : sefatayim:
content.english: Those fashioned by you, through your great goodness, through the fruit of your lips, your utterance —

content.hebrew: חֲ֒מֹל כַּפֵּר : אֲדוֹן כֹּפֶר : וְאַל תָּפֵר : בְּרִית תָּמִים :
content.transliteration: Ḥamol kapper : adon kofer : ve’al tafer : berit tamim:
content.english: For them, have compassion, and atone, O master of atonement; and do not annul the covenant of the perfect ones.

content.hebrew: זְ֒כֹר חֶסֶד : אָבוֹת יֹסֵד : וְיִפָּסֵד : עֲוֹן הֹמִים :
content.transliteration: Zechor ḥesed : avot yosed : veyippased : ‘avon homim:
content.english: Remember the constant kindness of the patriarchs, O founder [of the world]; and may the iniquity of the thronging masses be dropped.

content.hebrew: קָ֒רֵב יִשְׁעָם : דְּחֵה רִשְׁעָם : סְלַח פִּשְׁעָם : לְעוֹלָמִים :
content.transliteration: Ḳarev yish‘am : deḥē rish‘am : selaḥ pish‘am : le‘olamim:
content.english: Bring their rescue near, push away their wickedness, forgive their crimes forever!

content.hebrew: וּ֒בֶעָשׂוֹר : אָ֒שָׁם יַחְסֹר : מְ֒צֹא מַחְסֹר : צֳ֒רִי רָמִים :
content.transliteration: Uve‘asor : asham yaḥsor : metso maḥsor : tsori ramim:
content.english: And on the Tenth [of Tishri], may their guilt be gone; may the balm that is lacking be found for the lofty [Jews].

content.hebrew: סְלַח לָנוּ : וְעָלֵינוּ : זְרוֹק מַיִם : מְטֹהָרִים :
content.transliteration: Selaḥ lanu : ve‘alenu : zeroḳ mayim : metoharim:
content.english: Forgive us, and upon us pour water, such that we will be purified!

content.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפּוּרִים :
content.transliteration: Be‘etsem hayyom hazzē ki yom kippurim:
content.english: On this very day, for it is a day of atonement.
